T: Nike had one shot at Michael Jordan.
D: In 1984 Nike's basketball scout bets the company's whole basketball budget on signing a rookie called Michael Jordan.
P: Pour the old fashioneds when Deloris calls Sonny with her terms.
S: Crisp taquitos of chilli beef and cheese. The 7-Eleven clerk doubts Jordan.

Brown the mince with the onion, then add the cumin, chilli and passata and simmer until thick. Warm the tortillas so they bend, then fill each with chilli and cheese and roll up tight. Brush with oil and bake seam-side down at 220C until crisp. Serve with sour cream and salsa.
Prawn cocktail with a pink sauce. Sonny's big win at the Vegas tables.

Stir the mayonnaise, tomato sauce, Worcestershire and a squeeze of lemon together. Fill 4 coupes with lettuce and avocado. Pile on the prawns, spoon over the sauce and dust with paprika. Serve cold with lemon wedges.
M: Vinegar pulled pork, Carolina style. A visit to Wilmington.

Rub the pork with the sugar, paprika and salt and sit it in a lidded pot with 250ml water. Cover and cook at 160C until it pulls apart easily. Shake the vinegar, chilli flakes and tomato sauce together, then pull the pork and toss it through. Dress the cabbage with the mayo and a splash of the sauce and pile into the rolls with the pork.
Sonny asks George Raveling over dinner.

Boil the fries for 5 minutes, drain, toss with 2 tbsp oil and roast at 220C until crisp. Season the steaks and sear in the remaining oil to your liking, then rest. In the same pan melt the butter, soften the shallot, add the pepper, cream and mustard and bubble until thick. Serve the steaks with the fries and sauce.
W: Red velvet cake with cream cheese icing. Peter Moore names the shoe Air Jordan.

Whisk the flour, cocoa, bicarb and sugar, then beat in the oil, eggs, buttermilk, colouring and vinegar. Split between 2 lined 20cm tins and bake at 175C until a skewer comes out clean, then cool. Beat the cream cheese, butter and icing sugar until fluffy. Sandwich and cover the cakes with the icing and press the grated chocolate around the sides.
K: Bourbon, sugar and bitters stirred cold. Deloris wants a cut of every shoe sold.
Stir the bourbon, syrup and bitters with ice until very cold. Strain over fresh ice in 4 short glasses. Twist the orange peel over each glass and drop in with a cherry.
